scan.summary: This is the state's own licensing document: the OLCC recreational marijuana producer license for the Bailey Hill indoor grow, Tier II with a 10,000 sq ft mature canopy limit, covering the term March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027. Because it is the agency's document there is nothing in it for the company to correct — what matters is keeping it displayed at the premises, meeting the five conditions printed on it, and getting the renewal application and fee in before the 20-day cutoff. The current term runs out on March 2, 2027, which means the renewal must reach the Commission by about February 10, 2027.
scan.freshness_note: Issued 2026-03-03 for the current term; about six months old today and valid for roughly five more months. No newer version should exist until the 2027–2028 term is issued. Ask for the renewed license after March 2027.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on everything read off the face of the document — license number, entity, premises, tier, canopy, term dates, conditions and issue date are all printed on page 1 and quoted word for word. High confidence that this is a permit-class document with no gaps to fix, since it is the Commission's own instrument. The February 10, 2027 renewal date is inferred arithmetic from the document's own 20-day rule, not a date printed in the document; OAR 845-025-1070 independently sets a $150 late fee where a completed renewal arrives less than 20 days before expiry, which matches. I did not verify the exact current text of OAR 845-025-1190 (License Renewal) and am not certain whether OLCC's practice or rule has shifted on renewal timing or on labor peace agreement attestations for the 2027 cycle — confirm in CAMP when the renewal notice posts. I have not verified against OLCC records that this license is currently active, only that the paper says so; I also cannot tell from this document whether canopy, surveillance or worker permit conditions are actually being met on the ground.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
